summary: The best review note is that there are "a million little touches" elevating it. That is exactly why it lands: the gags are sharp, the animation is elastic, and even tiny expressions feel perfectly timed.
good_pick_if: you want a short classic that fires on every comic cylinder
maybe_skip_if: you need a bigger story than pure gag engineering

summary: The simple take that this is "the best toy story" still has plenty of defenders for a reason. It is bigger, funnier, and more emotionally dialed in than a sequel this toyetic has any right to be.

maybe_skip_if: animated nostalgia does not really move you
